snippet.title: DROVA Mobile Announcement Trailer / Coming April 23rd 2026
snippet.description:
On Mobile DROVA is exactly the experience PC and Console players would expect it to be: an old-school RPG. No quest-markers, just an open world to explore for you. No microtransactions. Players just pay once, the 9,99€, while the first area of the game will be made available for free so that players can judge for themselves if the game is to their liking. No cut content for Day 1 DLCs. There are no DLCs. No AI-generated content. Just a handcrafted world with 40 hours of content, a complex combat system and more than 250 characters to meet. DROVA stays true to its roots, the game which inspired it.

Coming to Android and iOS April 23rd.
More Infos: https://just2d.com/drova-mobile/
Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.Just2D.DrovaMobile
